name: 公園
description: A sunny park. A person is playing with a dog and a ball on the grass.

elements.label: 人
elements.accept: person, man, woman, boy, girl, someone, owner

elements.label: 人と犬が一緒に遊んでいる
elements.accept: the person and the dog are playing together, e.g. playing catch, throwing the ball to the dog
elements.partial: only says someone or something is playing, without connecting the person and the dog

name: 学校
description: A classroom at school. A teacher is giving a lesson and the students are listening. Some students are absent, so a few desks are empty.

elements.label: 先生
elements.partial: an adult, a man or a woman in front of the class

elements.label: 生徒が先生の授業を受けている
elements.accept: the teacher is teaching and the students are listening or studying, e.g. having a lesson, taking a class
elements.partial: says a lesson or studying without connecting the teacher and the students

elements.label: 数名の生徒が欠席している
elements.accept: some students are absent or not here, some seats or desks are empty
elements.partial: mentions empty seats or desks without saying students are missing, or says all but one

name: 台所
description: A small kitchen in the evening. A pot of soup is boiling on the stove, vegetables are on a cutting board, and a cat is sleeping on a chair.

elements.label: 鍋でスープを煮ている
elements.accept: a pot or soup is boiling or cooking on the stove
elements.partial: mentions a pot, soup or stove without saying it is cooking

elements.label: まな板の上の野菜
elements.partial: vegetables or a cutting board alone

elements.label: 猫が椅子の上で寝ている
elements.accept: the cat is sleeping or napping on a chair
elements.partial: the cat is sleeping without the chair, or the cat is on a chair without sleeping
